jd.title: Analytics Engineer
jd.text: Build trusted data models with dbt and SQL for finance and product teams. Define metrics, test data quality and publish dashboards in Looker. Python is a plus. Tell us how much reporting time you saved.

facts: Data Engineer with 4 years of experience in Python, SQL and PySpark.
Built PySpark pipelines processing 2 million daily orders from 6 source systems into a Delta Lake warehouse.
Reduced nightly batch runtime by 30% by repartitioning large tables and rewriting slow SQL joins.
Automated data quality checks in Python across 40 tables, catching schema drift before reports refreshed.
Modelled sales and inventory marts in SQL used by 3 analytics teams for weekly reporting.
Deployed Airflow DAGs for 12 scheduled jobs with failure alerts sent to the on-call channel.
Streamed sample order events through Kafka into a Python consumer running in Docker as a personal project.
Implemented a 3-stage lakehouse on sample retail data with schema evolution and time travel.
Worked with Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Factory for ingestion.
Mentored 2 junior engineers on code review and Git workflows.
